prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 medium close-up from a cheap regional hotel chat show, shot on a 1990s Betacam studio camera, head and hands sharp, the set falling soft behind. A masked host perched on the arm of a cream leatherette sofa sweeps one gloved hand toward a tiered plastic fountain while the other offers a glass of red wine to an empty guest chair. His bottle-green ribbed wool balaclava covers his whole head as one continuous knitted surface, with crown decreases and pilled fuzz; a cream-white felt ring is stitched around the face, and a solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside it on the right side of the frame, at two o'clock. Plain tan leather driving gloves, creased at the knuckles, vanish into the cuffs of a shiny burgundy blazer; the hood tucks into a buttoned black collar. Dusty fake ferns, one hot tungsten spotlight from frame left catching the wool fuzz. Thanks.
